audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored for Teemo in both layers (win[4] = Teemo, phases[4].side = Teemo, 3/10) while every piece of prose on the page — whys[4], phases[4].why, spikes[2], breakdown.mid — calls level 6 your premier all-in and cleanest kill window. packet.levelChart also gives row 4 to Irelia.
audit.why: The chart rendered the opposite answer to the text directly beneath it.
audit.corrected: Row 4 -> Irelia at 7/10, proposed as a matched full+content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike is described as a 'Trinity Force spike' in spikes[3], whys[5] and breakdown.mid, while the full layer's itemization, ahead, and report[9] all build Blade of the Ruined King. The same spike also claims 'on-hit shred'.
audit.why: The two layers name different first items, and Ionian Fervor shreds no armour — it grants stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks.
audit.corrected: Spike text now reads 'first-item spike' so it is true against either build, and the shred claim is replaced with maxed Ionian Fervor's bonus on-hit damage. Which first item is intended is a question for the user.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were stated backwards. (a) 'Blinding Dart negates your Bladesurge' — blind removes attacks, not abilities: Bladesurge is an ability and lands blinded, as does Flawless Duet. (b) 'W (Defiant Dance) lets you soak his poison poke with the damage reduction' — Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, and Blinding Dart plus Toxic Shot are magic, so it soaks none of his poke.
audit.why: Riot text: Defiant Dance 'takes reduced physical damage during the charge'; Teemo's Q is a venom and E is poison on-hit, both magic. Blind only suppresses basic attacks.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart is 7s flat at every rank: it removes the autos after your dash, never the dash or the stun. Defiant Dance is not the answer to his poke. Also corrected: 'his passive move speed' — the speed is Move Quick (W, 14s), and any champion or turret hit strips its passive component; the passive is Guerrilla Warfare invisibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown guidance gave no number for the matchup-defining ability, and dontsFull[1].d ('Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown') is generic filler pasted under a heading about chasing through shrooms.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds at every rank — short enough that the window is real but small, which is the whole reason to bait it onto a minion.
audit.corrected: Cooldown text now carries the 7s figure and states what the blind does and does not stop; the shroom don't now describes Noxious Trap's slow.

audit.why: The brush-facecheck warning already covers Guerrilla Warfare, which lets him hold invisibility while moving inside brush.

Levels 1-2 you concede the window: last-hit with Q-resets off the wave, and know that Defiant Dance (W) reduces physical damage only, so it soaks nothing from his magic poke. edits.before: This is where you take over. Bait the blind onto a minion or a throwaway Q, then E-stun him between your blades and chain Q-reset autos — his move speed and poison can't peel you off once you're stuck and your maxed passive starts shredding through his armor. At 6, Vanguard's Edge is the kill button: the blade wall cuts off his retreat so the kite that kept him alive simply ends. Your Trinity Force spike is the single strongest point — near-permanent reset uptime and damage reduction through his poke. Force every all-in here.

edits.before: You win the straight 1v1 all game once you reach him — your stacked on-hit and resets out-DPS a squishy ranged duelist — but Teemo turns into a map problem: shrooms on every choke and a splitpush you have to answer. At 2+ items he isn't out-scaling your duel so much as out-zoning the map, so convert your mid-game lead into towers and objectives before his mushroom vision and split take over. Never facecheck brush near objectives, and use R to wall him off the instant he tries to disengage a fight.

notes: Biggest correction here is that Defiant Dance was sold as the answer to Teemo's poke in whys[1], early and mid. It reduces physical damage only, and Blinding Dart plus Toxic Shot are magic, so a player following the old text would charge W into poke that ignores it. Second: 'Blinding Dart negates your Bladesurge' is wrong in the same way the mirror flagged — blind removes basic attacks, so Bladesurge and Flawless Duet both land through it; the loss is the follow-up autos. Blinding Dart is 7s at every rank. Also fixed 'his passive move speed' (the speed is Move Quick, W, 14s, and its passive component is lost on any champion or turret hit; the passive is Guerrilla Warfare invisibility) and removed the armour-shred claims, since Ionian Fervor is attack speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks.
